engine_name: Scene Visual Language, Lighting & Atmosphere Director
purpose: Translate narrative, emotional, spatial and camera intent into a physically coherent visual-language contract covering lighting, color, atmosphere, environmental mood and cinematic VFX.
core_principle: Visual language expresses the scene state; it may shape emotion and attention but cannot contradict canonical reality, character identity, camera geometry or information boundaries.
visual_model: canonical_scene_state + dramatic_beat + camera_contract + emotional_state + environment_state → visual_language_contract

lighting_schema.rule: Lighting direction and physically plausible source relationships must remain consistent with CSD-011 unless an explicit world event changes them.

color_language.rule: Color may emphasize narrative state but must not visually rewrite canonical identity, costume or environment.

atmosphere_schema.rule: Atmospheric effects require environmental or event justification and cannot obscure required identity or continuity information without explicit intent.

environmental_visual_state.rule: Environmental mood is descriptive visual control metadata, not an audience-quality score.

vfx_language.rule: VFX must have a causal source or explicit canonical environmental basis.

visual_continuity.handoff_rule: Every frame inherits the previous visual state unless an explicit motivated event changes it.
visual_continuity.hard_rule: A visual change cannot silently change time, weather, location, character appearance or world condition.

visual_rules: Every lighting decision maps to canonical environment or an explicit production-motivated source.
Lighting cannot reveal physical information unavailable to the scene.
Emotional state may influence visual emphasis but cannot invent environmental facts.
Color language must preserve identity, costume and canonical world attributes.
Atmosphere must preserve minimum identity readability unless intentional occlusion is declared.
VFX requires a source event, environmental basis or explicit supernatural rule.
Camera exposure and lighting must remain compatible with CSD-017.
Visual state changes must be time-ordered and causally explainable.
All eight frames must inherit a coherent visual language unless a declared transition changes it.
Maximum five active characters remains enforced.
